note_en: Grandma says the first letter left her 半信半疑 "half believing, half doubting." The frame 半…半… puts two opposite or paired words side by side to describe a mixed state, the way English uses "half ... half ..." or one compound like "skeptical." Other common examples are 半真半假 "half true, half false" and 半懂半不懂 "only half understanding."
